description: Deploy Salesforce metadata through the Metadata API REST resources under /services/data/v{version}/metadata on the registered org. Operations: deploy (POST /metadata/deployRequest as multipart/form-data: a json part with deployOptions and a file part with the .zip package read from an ABSOLUTE zip_path under a saved location; deployOptions members allowMissingFiles, autoUpdatePackage, checkOnly (validate only), ignoreWarnings, performRetrieve, purgeOnDelete, rollbackOnError and singlePackage are booleans, testLevel is NoTestRun, RunSpecifiedTests, RunRelevantTests, RunLocalTests or RunAllTestsInOrg, runTests lists Apex test classes; a destructiveChanges.xml in the package deletes components), deploy_status (GET /metadata/deployRequest/{deploy_request_id}; query includeDetails), deploy_cancel (PATCH the same path with deployResult status Canceling) and deploy_quick (POST /metadata/deployRequest/{deploy_request_id} with body validatedDeployRequestId of a successful checkOnly validation). Retrieve, describeMetadata, listMetadata and readMetadata are SOAP-only calls and are not reachable through this verb. Salesforce permissions alone decide each deployment, including deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Deploy Salesforce metadata from a zip package: validate it with a check-only run, choose which Apex tests run, deploy for real, delete components with destructive changes, watch deployment progress, cancel a running deployment, and quick-deploy a validated one. Use for release automation and org configuration changes; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP; 201 for a started deployment, 202 for a cancellation), selected headers, body (id and url of the deployRequest, deployOptions, and deployResult with status Pending, InProgress, Succeeded, SucceededPartial, Failed, Canceling or Canceled, numberComponentsDeployed, numberComponentsTotal, numberComponentErrors, numberTestsCompleted, numberTestErrors and, with includeDetails, componentFailures, componentSuccesses and runTestResults), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, and failures (component plus test errors, at least 1) when the deployment status is Failed or SucceededPartial.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A 201 means the deployment started, not that it succeeded: poll deploy_status with includeDetails until deployResult.status is Succeeded, SucceededPartial, Failed or Canceled, then relay status and any componentFailures with their problem text. checkOnly true changed nothing; its id is what deploy_quick takes. A deploy without checkOnly, a quick deploy and destructive changes change the org.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Deploy metadata with the registered user's Modify Metadata or Modify All Data permission.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, deploy_request_id (a 15- or 18-character id), zip_path (an absolute .zip path that must be a zip archive), deployOptions (an object whose boolean members are booleans, testLevel one of the five documented values, runTests a list of class names), includeDetails (a boolean) or the validatedDeployRequestId body member does not match the vendor shape. sf.import_path_refused: the path must be absolute, have the required suffix where specified, and lie under a saved path address, the session folder or solet home, outside the installation tree. Input files must already exist. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.bad_request (400), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404, including no validation that qualifies for a quick deploy), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read deployResult and its componentFailures before retrying; a failed deployment is reported as data, not raised. A permission error means the registered user lacks Modify Metadata Through Metadata API Functions or Modify All Data. Production deployments need rollbackOnError true and a test level that meets coverage. Never retry a deploy automatically; check deploy_status first.
